messages:
auditor_emily: Hi team, auditor here. For the ISO/SOC2 fieldwork we need evidence that the recent RBAC cleanup and KMS rotation didn't increase risk. Please provide: 1) role change diff, 2) auth logs for the 48h window around the change, 3) KMS rotation manifest + key metadata, 4) sample encrypted object list with ETags and encryption-context, 5) vuln triage link and short timeline.

sam: Hi Emily — Sam from SecOps. We can do that. Narrow window 48h + 90d change history? Which do you prefer for audit scope?

auditor_emily: 90d is preferred but 48h around the rollout is acceptable if you include full change history for the service account and approver audit trail. Checksums required for each artifact.

rachel: Infra here. We have PR #7124 for the RBAC cleanup (removed unused clusterrole and reduced verb scope). I can export the git diff and the merged PR metadata. Will include approvals.

rachel: Example diff we'll attach: `git show --name-only --pretty="format:%H %an %ai" origin/main~1..origin/main` and the PR snapshot JSON.

sam: For auth logs we'll export CloudTrail + internal auth proxy logs. Path (temporary presigned): `https://s3-presigned.redwood/evidence/1705012345/auth-logs-48h.jsonl.gz` (expires 7d). MD5/sha256 will be alongside.

infra_bot: presigned URL created for s3://redwood-evidence/iso/1705012345/auth-logs-48h.jsonl.gz (valid 7 days).

sam: KMS rotation executed 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z. We'll include rotation-manifest.json, DescribeKey outputs for old/new ARNs, and CloudTrail KMS events bundle. sha256: d2c7... (full checksum in package).

auditor_emily: Need explicit evidence there were no plaintext copies during re-encryption and that old key material cannot decrypt new ciphertexts. Also need approver identities & timestamps.

rachel: We will include a sampling manifest with 8 objects (object key, ETag, encryption-context) and a decrypt test script showing old key decryption fails for re-encrypted ciphertexts. Example command: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old || echo "failed as expected"`

sam: Vulnerability triage: CVE-2026-0777 affected a component; patched on 2026-03-16, image rebuild and rolling deploy finished before the RBAC change. Triage doc: https://go.redwood/triage/CVE-2026-0777 — will add timeline summary to manifest.

auditor_emily: Please email package to auditor.iso@redwood.com and include GPG signature if possible. Also state whether any emergency hotfixes or manual credential changes were performed.

rachel: No emergency hotfixes or credential resets were performed. Approvers: @alex (2026-03-17T20:12:05Z), @sam (2026-03-17T20:20:30Z). Adding statement to signed manifest.

sam: ETA: full signed bundle + README + checksums in 2 business days. I'll DM the presigned links once uploaded.

auditor_emily: Thanks — that should work. :thumbsup:
